What is the best way to refinish stairs? In this video, we compare five popular stair-finishing methods based on cost, difficulty, durability and traction.

The five options include tile, sanding and staining, veneered stair treads, solid hardwood treads and vinyl stair treads. Each method has different advantages depending on the condition of your staircase, your budget, the tools you own and your DIY skill level.
